title: Probe constituents bracketed by an input segmenter
summary: An input segmenter groups the context into constituents. For a probe x it supplies the constituent x, g(x), f(g(x)) and marks its right edge, so the reader emits the symbol at that edge. Other tasks use a double-ended list of stored symbols.
core_idea: Read two-table compositions off the right edge of the constituent an input segmenter forms around each probe.

state.name: L2
state.meaning: Double-ended list of C stored (address, symbol) entries, C = 64.

state.name: lev
state.meaning: Bracket level; the list's back end serves as push-down.

state.name: edge
state.meaning: Right-edge symbol of the constituent the segmenter forms around the current probe, delivered with the probe.

state.name: Mp
state.meaning: Learned map from edge symbol to output.

update.plain: the segmenter delivers the right-edge symbol of the probe's constituent
update.name: edge

update.latex: wt=\varnothing \Rightarrow wt \leftarrow x_t;\;\text{else push-back } (wt, x_t),\; m2 \leftarrow m2+1
update.plain: pairs are pushed on the back of the list
update.name: push-back

readout.latex: \hat{y}_t = Mp[edge_t] \text{ (compositions)};\; \text{entry of } x_t \text{ in } L2 \text{ (other pairs)}
readout.plain: a composition probe emits Mp of the edge symbol; recall and chains read the list entry stored for x_t, followed again for chains; brackets read the back entry

learning.description: Mp by majority over the m training items; routing chosen by training accuracy.
learning.few_shot_argument: Mp is the identity on 16 symbols; m = 12 items of 16 probes cover them.

complexity.constants_notes: List reads scan at most C entries; the edge arrives with the probe.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Segmenter edges leave only Mp to learn.

prediction.statement: From m = 12 composition items at T = 16, per-query accuracy is at least 0.99.

capabilities.prediction: Exact at T = 4, 16, 32 from edge symbols.
The limit is a storage count: C slots of two words cannot hold more than C pairs, so at C = 64 an instance with 65 or more distinct pairs loses one of them.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.relation: This card does not compare its mechanism with others.
known_relatives.claimed_difference: No difference from earlier work is claimed.

falsifiers: 12 items at T = 16 after which composition accuracy is below 0.99.
A recall instance with K <= 64 answered wrongly.

toy_example.description: Edges for T = 2 tables computed by a scan.
